import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query hourly AQHI for station 15 (Central/Western) for the specified periods
query = text("""
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00' AND datetime < '2025-01-25 00:00:00' THEN 'weekday'
        WHEN datetime >= '2025-01-25 00:00:00' AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00' THEN 'weekend'
    END as period,
    aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
  AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
  AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
  AND aqhi IS NOT NULL
""")

df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Compute means
weekday_mean_aqhi = float(df[df['period'] == 'weekday']['aqhi'].mean())
weekend_mean_aqhi = float(df[df['period'] == 'weekend']['aqhi'].mean())

# Print summary statistics
print(f"Weekday (Jan 20-24) - Count: {df[df['period']=='weekday'].shape[0]}, Mean AQHI: {weekday_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
print(f"Weekend (Jan 25-26) - Count: {df[df['period']=='weekend'].shape[0]}, Mean AQHI: {weekend_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
print(f"Difference (weekend - weekday): {weekend_mean_aqhi - weekday_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
